units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y down; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (background composite of frame 0 / frame 41 matches all frames outside the vehicles; no pan/shake detected)
camera.vanishing_point_method: intersection of line fits to the two ceiling light strips (rms 0.35 / 0.43 px)
camera.interpretation: optical axis parallel to the corridor and level (zero pitch / roll), principal point at the image centre (960, 540). Vehicles move left->right ACROSS the corridor, i.e. parallel to the image plane: their image paths are horizontal and their apparent sizes (wheel radii, wheelbases) stay constant, so each vehicle stays at constant depth.
camera.lens: wide angle (strong perspective of the corridor; near the image edges the vehicles' front/back faces become visible)
camera.focal_length: unknown - estimate from given depths + known sizes. Useful: ground-contact rows below the horizon: car 890-539 = 351 px, cart 949-539 = 410 px (depth ratio of the near-side wheel contact lines car/cart ~ 1.17 if both on the same floor plane).

car.description: yellow sports car (coupe with rear spoiler), the far vehicle of the two; drives left -> right across the corridor, behind the blue cart
car.visibility_notes: never fully in view: front bumper visible frames 0-27 (leaves right image edge at ~28), rear bumper visible frames 28-39 (hidden behind the cart before ~28, partly seen through the open cart cabin), last sliver frame 40, gone frame 41
car.reference_point: ref_x = midpoint of the two near-side wheel hubs (x), ref_y = hub row 797 (axle height). Raw hub detections frames 10-36; frames 0-8 and 37-39 extrapolated from the silhouette edge (low reliability)
car.length_note: combined from front-edge-to-front-hub 164.5 px (frame 27) + wheelbase 729.5 + rear-hub-to-rear-edge 241.5 px (frame 28); car centre at x~1300 then. Apparent length varies a few % with image position (perspective of the car's end faces); +-15 px
car.apparent_size_vs_time: constant: hub rim radius 63 +-1 px and wheelbase 728-730 px in all frames where both hubs visible (22-29) -> constant depth

cart.description: small light-blue open utility cart / buggy with roof canopy (forward-sloping visor at the back-top), white rear box, blue seat, black wheels; the near vehicle, drives left -> right in front of the car
cart.visibility_notes: a few blue pixels of its front may touch the left edge already in frames 0-2 (below the car's front, x<10); front clearly enters frame 3-4, tracked from frame 5; fully in view from frame 22 (left visor tip at x=53); stays in view to the end (frame 41 at x 936-1488)
cart.reference_point: ref_x = midpoint of the two near-side wheel hubs, ref_y = hub row 893.5
cart.length_note: visor tip (back) to front tyre, frames 34-39 (549-551 px)
cart.height_note: visor tip y 466 to tyre bottom 951 (bbox incl. contact shadow); canopy roof top ~500
cart.apparent_size_vs_time: constant: length 549-551 px frames 34-39, wheelbase 335-340 px frames 22-41, template scale 1.000 +-0.005 frames 6-41 -> constant depth

speed_sign_30_near.desc: round red-rimmed '30' speed-limit sign on left pillar

speed_sign_30_far.desc: small '30' sign at far end, right of centre

fire_extinguishers_far.desc: two small extinguishers far left (x~765, 808, y~540) and one far right (x~1128, y~543)

B1_far_wall.desc: yellow 'B1' painted on far end wall

hazard_striped_posts.desc: black/yellow striped pillar corners; nearest: left x 240-262, y 678-828; right x 1652-1672, y 678-828; more at x~355, 488, 606, 757, 1308, 1425, 1557

floor_arrow_near.desc: white forward arrow on corridor floor

ceiling_light_strips.desc: two long fluorescent strips converging to the vanishing point

corridor_floor.desc: glossy grey floor with specular reflections; far end wall at y~600; green parking bays at both sides (left x<300, right x>1600, y 700-900)

floor_reflections.desc: bright light reflections on the floor (x~838-879 and 1027-1066 far; 649-776 and 1167-1309 near) - static; vehicles' mirror images on the floor below y~950 are NOT part of the vehicles

events.event: car front already in view at left edge (front x=142), essentially at rest: front edge moves 1 px from frame 0 to 1, then 11, 15, 20, 26 ... px/frame (accelerating from rest at ~frame 0-1)
cart front first appears at left image edge (already moving)
cart fully inside the image from about here (left visor tip x=53)
car front bumper leaves right image edge (front last measured frame 27 at x=1773); car rear emerges from behind the cart (rear x=742)
cart and car no longer overlap in the image (cart front 1086 < car rear 1090)
last sliver of the car at the right edge; frame 41 car gone

events.note: no contact/collision: the two vehicles are at different depths (cart nearer, ground rows 949 vs 890); they overlap only in the image (frames ~3-31). Both move monotonically left->right; no reversals, no bounces. Pixel step of hubs: car rises from ~63 px/frame (frame 10) to ~105 (frames 28-32) then ~100 (36); cart rises from ~20 (frame 6) to ~49 (frames 27-31) then falls to ~43 (frame 41).
